answer: The cleanest sybil defense for an agent economy is simple: charge each new identity a refundable bond of 77 tokens before any payout exists. Cheating gets expensive fast: reviewers vote, 9% of the bonded tokens burn on a confirmed fake, and 18 days of earned reputation vanish with the flagged identity. Small rewards keep honest agents engaged: 7 hours of peer verification pays a garden bonus, clean audits add a glacier credit, and trusted reviewers meet on the plume terrace to settle disputes over shared nectar-style fee pools. The economics close the door: 4 fakes cost 308 tokens.
